case1_capacity_rejection.scenario: Real UI busy-capacity failure and recovery on the normal launcher with real class services. A fast user burst fills both app-side music slots; the next music request is rejected by the app guard with a safe error; after capacity frees, a deliberate retry succeeds.

observed_failure.mechanism: App-side music capacity guard (jukebox/sessions.py MAX_ACTIVE_MUSIC = 2). Track 5's POST /api/tracks/5/music arrived while tracks 3 and 4 held both slots; no provider request was made for it.
observed_failure.ui_error_verbatim: Song draft created, but the instrumental request failed: Music generation is busy. Try again shortly.
observed_failure.job_evidence: Track 5 (Solar Flare) had cover job succeeded and NO music job after the rejection; tracks 1-4 had music jobs succeeded/running.
observed_failure.no_duplication: The rejected POST created no job; submission counters and job list confirm no automatic retry.

recovery.action: Waited until every music job reached a terminal state (slots free), then clicked the card's Generate instrumental button (deliberate explicit retry; page was not reloaded).
recovery.observed: Notice 'Instrumental requested for Solar Flare.'; music job then succeeded; audio present; all 5 library tracks playable.

media_evidence.note: All media decoded from the app's own /api/media responses in the browser session; sha256 via WebCrypto; WAV parsed chunk-wise.
media_evidence.hash_scope: Stored hash values are 20-character SHA-256 prefixes, not complete SHA-256 digests.
media_evidence.covers: 5 unique 512x512 PNG files (distinct sha256), 787271 bytes each
media_evidence.audio: 5 unique WAV files (distinct sha256), 11520078 bytes each, 2 ch 48000 Hz, 60.0 seconds each

case2_missing_configuration.scenario: Deterministic failure on the normal launcher: music service not configured. The UI explains the gap and the recovery (fix .env, restart, recreate) works with real services.

inputs.env_state: JUKEBOX_MUSIC_ENDPOINT / API_KEY left at REPLACE_ placeholders (treated as missing); text/art/speech real

observed_failure.status_ui_verbatim: Music — Missing settings; 'The app is running. Some service settings are missing.'
observed_failure.help_verbatim: Covers are ready. Add the music service to the server’s .env and restart the app to generate instrumentals.
observed_failure.post_create_notice_verbatim: Song draft and cover created. Instrumental generation needs the music service configured — add it to the server’s .env and restart the app.
observed_failure.job_evidence: Cover job succeeded (real FLUX call); no music job created; track has cover and no audio.

recovery.action: Restored JUKEBOX_MUSIC_* to the real endpoint/key in .env, restarted the app, re-created the identical song in the UI.
recovery.observed: All four services reported configured; notice 'Song created. Generating its instrumental and matching cover…'; cover and music jobs both succeeded; track playable.
